title: Award Desk Questions on Repeat Award Tickets in the Agreement Year (Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements)
content:
**What sets the award repeat percentage of a domestic Crestline Main Cabin round-trip award under Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements?**
The award tickets already redeemed on the agreement in its current agreement year. They are counted as the award-ticket redemption entries dated fewer whole calendar months before the redemption date than the whole months that agreement year has run plus one. The whole months the agreement year has run are counted from the latest anniversary of the approval date, an agreement year running 12 months.

| Award tickets already redeemed in the current agreement year | Award repeat percentage |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | 110 percent |
| at least 1, fewer than 3 | 105 percent |
| none | 100 percent (the listed price) |

**Which redemptions count?**
Award-ticket redemptions only, of any award ticket and for any roster traveler; upgrades and status awards are not award tickets and do not count.

**How are the months applied? (hypothetical)**
An agreement approved on 1 March, redeeming on 20 June, has run 3 whole months of its agreement year; the award-ticket redemption entries counted are those dated fewer than 4 whole calendar months before 20 June.

**How does the percentage act?**
The award repeat percentage multiplies the standard domestic award price, the tier's domestic Main Cabin round-trip award points. Where the price carries several such percentages, they are all applied together to the standard price, each divided by one hundred, and the product is rounded to the nearest whole point once.

**What does an agreement with 2 earlier award tickets this agreement year pay, with no other percentage? (hypothetical)**
1600 multiplied by 105 and divided by one hundred: 1680 points.
